llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Tremendous connector that can read and create reward-related data, with explicit confirmation required before write actions.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to operate Tremendous through OOMOL, and the artifact lists Tremendous read actions plus reward/order creation capabilities that match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The description routes any Tremendous request to the skill, which is broad, but the runtime instructions require schema inspection and user confirmation before state-changing actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is a single markdown file and does not include executable payloads; it documents installing the oo CLI via remote install commands only when the CLI is missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The requested tool access is limited to Bash commands beginning with oo, and credentials are described as handled server-side by OOMOL rather than exposed to the agent.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: One-time CLI login and Tremendous connection setup may persist account access through OOMOL, but this is disclosed and tied to the connector’s purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let an agent use your OOMOL-connected Tremendous account. Treat reward orders and redemption links as sensitive financial actions, review payloads carefully, and require explicit approval before creating orders or links.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad Tremendous routing is real, but it is disclosed in the description and bounded by instructions to confirm exact payloads and effects before write actions, so it is a user-guidance note rather than a Review-level concern.
